## Current PM

⏳ **vacant**, signed off 2026-11-01T01:40Z on the maintainer's 「当前任务处理完，合并后就下班」 (2026-10-31T22:42Z, in the `os-sales` account's Claude project "Objectstack ui"). The previous holder was `os-sales`, session `session_01L6bhgUhKx1XHzkoikGjRB4`, seated 2026-10-31T03:06Z. The newest comment on this post is the sign-off brief. To take over, run `/pm-dispatch 接手` and read this post first.

## Handover ledger

- **In flight:** none. `check-handover.mjs` exits 0. Every card this tenure claimed has landed (landing note on the card) or been released with what remains named in its `Release:`: #28073 (PR #28300); #25921 partial (barrel batch PR #28385, helper bodies PR #28402; released to `pm:queue`); #28406 partial (items 1/2/3/5 PR #28422; released, item 4 split to domain:spec); #27524 ④ (PR #28458), #28434 (PR #28457), #28370 (PR #28475), #27058 (PR #28477), #28471 (PR #28494).
- **Follow-ups filed by this seat, open:** #28461 (record counter on grouped lists / kanban lanes, p3, now claimed by seat 1); #28476 (skills: teach the view filter `{ or }` group, domain:skills, Tier H); #28483 (phone record page: two bars and the app bar repeats the record name; `needs-user-decision`, the maintainer rules where the app menu, search, notifications and account go); #28484 (phone list card row face, `plugin-grid`, p3, `pm:queue`). #28462 (types related-list `{ or }` filter mirror) is seat 4's, PR #28466, unblocked by #28475.
- **Decision box:** #28483 (this tenure); #27328 (inherited from the `os-warren` tenure, still awaiting the ruling).
- **Queue snapshot (domain:ui `pm:queue`, unclaimed, at sign-off):** #25918, #25921, #27521, #28484 (all p3). Seat 1 (`os-tesla`, re-seated 2026-10-31T22:50Z) holds #27059, #27520 and #28461.
- **Cross-lane memo:** for domain:spec, `ViewFilterOrGroupSchema`'s `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` marker can go now that #28475 renders the group (landing note on #28370).

## Hot-file serial queue

- **This seat holds:** nothing. ⛔ Re-derive from the live `Claim:` comments and each open PR's file list before every dispatch.
- **File area (for the next holder):** no fixed area; seat 1 (#25966) holds every `domain:ui` path not split to seats 2–5.
- **Excluded:** the `pm:epic` subtrees. `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` stay ⛔ out of bounds for ui cards.

## Notes

- **Standing constraints (maintainer):** changesets for ui cards go to the root `.changeset/`; no PR on the objectui repository; `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` gates every ui card; seats self-review at the contract tier and land PRs they ACCEPTed; governed Tier H and over-3000-line PRs still wait for the human approval.
- **Traps seen this tenure:** `app-shell`'s `type-check` is `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` (a card thread running only the first half missed a test-file break); `ui/e2e/record-header-title-width.spec.ts` source-scans the last `className="..."` literal before `role="toolbar"` in `containers.tsx`; the card threads could not download CI failure artifacts (blob host refused by the network policy) and reproduced locally instead.
- **Mailbox:** none was opened for this tenure (seat reached by comments on this post).
- **Routine:** the hourly patrol this session made is deleted at sign-off.
- **Wall:** none.
